svg.text: Whisper is not merely worse. It is worse at knowing it is worse.

svg.text: POPULATION — the 10-clip intersection: the 1,757 cells all three arms actually ran (176

svg.text: conditions × 10 clips per arm).

svg.text: nova-3 also ran 40 clips, and on THAT population its dead-zone rate reads 1.14% (2 of

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 176), not the 0.57% below. Both are correct; quoting one without its clip count is the bug.

svg.text: Why elevenlabs-scribe has no bar: it returns a DIFFERENT transcript for byte-identical audio

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on repeat calls (A7X42 vs “A seven X four two”), and a dead zone is defined by an ABSOLUTE

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WER threshold — so its 7 strict dead zones fall to 0 under the cross-model normalizer. They

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: were spelling, not confident error. Rank statistics survive that noise, attenuated, so its rho in

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel B is a lower bound.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: B. Does confidence track error? Spearman rho — more negative is better

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rank of that arm's own confidence against rank of its WER, over its non-mute conditions

svg.text: The rho row is over a DIFFERENT condition count per arm (nova-3 164 / elevenlabs-scribe

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 174 / whisper-base 171) because each arm goes mute on a different set of conditions. The clip

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set is shared; the condition population is not.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The dead-zone COUNT is threshold-fragile — but the ORDER is not: nova-3 is strictly below

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: whisper-base at all 63 of 63 threshold pairs swept on this same population (WER ≥ 0.10…0.50

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: × confidence percentile 0.30…0.90).

svg.text: Source: results/master.csv via deadzone.analysis.model_arms.arm_intersection, which takes

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the intersection and returns the census — never a cross-arm mean over unmatched clips.
